context: News: Sakura and Ren on a housing-construction safety rule.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: news report; construction vocabulary (建設/住宅/危険/土地/メーカー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 住宅の建設現場で、新しい規則が始まります。
lines.en: A new rule begins at housing construction sites.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 建設現場は、危険が多いんですか?
lines.en: Are construction sites full of danger?
lines.style: measured young reporter voice, soft warm serious focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええ、高い場所での作業は危険です。
lines.en: Yes, work at heights is dangerous.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メーカーは、どう対応しますか?
lines.style: serious young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 各メーカーが、安全策を導入します。
lines.en: Each maker will introduce safety measures.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 土地の確保も、課題ですね。
lines.en: Securing land is a challenge too.
lines.style: thoughtful young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 狭い土地での建設は、特に危険です。
lines.en: Construction on tight land is especially risky.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 住宅の安全が、守られるといいですね。
lines.en: I hope housing safety is protected.
lines.style: earnest young reporter voice, soft warm calm closing throughout
